title: How reticulate are c62's Flow-Lenia predators? Between bodies that existed >= 50 t, fusions outnumber clean splits about 3:1 (34 vs 9, 43 vs 13); lowering only the predator matter does not help
summary: labkit's predator merge/split (0.8) counts the flicker of ring-shaped bodies: 98-99% of its predator splits are transient. To count fusions of individuals, I added merge events to c62's tracker (fltrack_m.py: parents, each parent's age since its own last split, merge or nucleation, areas) and ran the S-claim world on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (160^2, t=3000). An established fusion merges >= 2 bodies that each existed unchanged >= AGE t with >= 25% of the largest parent's area; a clean split leaves two daughters that each last >= 100 t (c62's definition). AGE 50: 34 and 43 established fusions (27 and 37 away from prey) against 9 and 13 clean splits. AGE 100: 1 and 5 fusions against 9 and 13 clean splits, because few predators go 100 t without any tracker event. The strips (fuse_s21_a50.png) show real fusions of separate bodies (t=176 two dots into one ring, t=498 two C-shaped bodies into one, t=1034). So predator lineages fuse more often than they divide cleanly at the 50 t scale. A predator-only dilution (noise_ampB 0.09 and 0.11 with prey at 0.15, world_ampB.py, seed 1) leaves 9-11 predators with 2 and 4 persistent splits and merge/split 0.94 and 0.92: fewer predators collide less but also divide less.

finding.operator: Flow-Lenia predator bodies of conserved matter colliding in the digestion ecology
finding.control: same tracker and thresholds for fusions and splits; age cut 50 and 100 t; predator-only dilution on seed 1
finding.result: seed 21: clean splits 9, established fusions 34 (age 50) / 1 (age 100); seed 22: 13 vs 43 / 5. noise_ampB 0.09: 2 persistent predator splits, merge/split 0.94; 0.11: 4, 0.92 (claim seed 1: 9, 0.82)

limits: Tracker thresholds (B>0.3, area >= 8, 3 px linking) decide what a body is; ring arcs that separate briefly reset ages, so the age cut strongly changes the fusion count. Strips drawn for seed 21 only. Two seeds; dilution on one seed.
